history_support.statistics_unit: Equal batches; offspring averaged within each extant parent and score stratum
history_support.target_semantics: Recorded high-score child endpoint feature minus its selected parent forecast. First node has no edge and an explicit zero placeholder.
history_support.whole_window_rate_definition: Sum of observed success-minus-failure edge increments divided by elapsed time; first-node placeholder excluded
history_support.rate_formula: For independent batch b: r_b=(sum_{j=1}^{49}[mean_success_parent_edge_delta_z(b,j)-mean_failure_parent_edge_delta_z(b,j)])/(0.49-0). Report mean_b r_b and batch CI/FDR. Exclude j=0: no observed edge. No trapezoid treating that zero placeholder as an observation.
history_support.interpretation: Only landmark_00_softmin passes V3, with rate -4.914369782450085 z per unit model time, CI [-6.854885532781242,-2.6157352943386276], 13/14 negative batches and q=0.04608273058076118. Landmark_00_occupancy3 has q=0.08105526993766458 and is not history-supported despite coordinate support. This is an observational forecast-feature edge contrast, not physical atom velocity or a causal persistence mechanism. The future penalty targets recorded successful per-edge increments, not this global success-minus-failure rate: the target is -1.1789173480595225 at t=.01 but +0.11909325047405649 at t=.49. Screening uses high-minus-low window contrast, whereas the optional reward matches the absolute high-score mean increment. High edges sum to -1.4667331286332943 and low edges to 0.9413080647672474; the high target has 22 positive and 27 negative edges. At the first observed edge, high delta is -1.1789173480595225 but high-minus-low is 0.04861708018195943. Thus the high target is neither a constant negative force nor a certified persistence mechanism.

mathematical_definition.features: Use exactly the existing numpy_geometry/torch_geometry Phi in persistent_reward.py, with the reference origin and receptor landmarks; z(Y)=Phi(Y)/s, using every fixed reference scale s in the declared feature order. The 74-vector mask and 24 actual 50-node functions above are literal copies, not new fits.
mathematical_definition.prototypes: For supported node n and each original reference elite p, T_np=Phi(teacher_endpoint_A[n,p])/s. Keep each prototype separate. These are the reference's recorded elite endpoints, not newly measured R7 outputs.
mathematical_definition.variance: v_nk=mean over the recorded frame rows of variance_scaled[n,:,k], exactly as implementation; use it in both attraction and history residuals.
mathematical_definition.supported_block_weights: With mask m_k and block(k)=b, w_k=B_b*m_k/sum_{l in b}m_l when that supported mass is positive, otherwise zero. Thus before salience: selected shape fields have 1/2 each, pair fields 2/5 each and landmark fields 1/17 each; centroid mass is zero.
mathematical_definition.empirical_continuous_function: For adjacent recorded times t_n<=t<=t_(n+1), e_k(t)=(1-alpha)*values_z[k,n]+alpha*values_z[k,n+1], alpha=(t-t_n)/(t_(n+1)-t_n). Runtime here accepts exact recorded nodes (2e-6 tolerance) and reads the matching values_z directly. Do not extrapolate outside recorded support or replace nodes by a polynomial.
mathematical_definition.salience: a_nk=clip(abs(e_k(t_n)),0.1,2); W_nk=w_k*a_nk. Unsupported fields remain zero. persistent_reward.py does not normalize block masses a second time after salience, so the effective per-node block mass may vary; log those masses. e is a detached empirical association, not d e/dt used as a spatial derivative.
mathematical_definition.prototype_prior: log pi_np=log_softmax_p[2*(teacher_score_np-mean_p teacher_score_np)]. These fixed joint latent-head score priors are detached labels, not measured binding affinities or a differentiable affinity head.
mathematical_definition.attraction: A_n(Y)=tau*logsumexp_p(log pi_np-C(q_np(Y))/tau), tau=0.5. Since sum pi=1 and C>=0, A_n<=0, a finite upper bound. It is not bounded below, and matching one prototype need not reach zero when other alternatives remain distant.
mathematical_definition.optional_history_weights: h_k=w_k*history_mask_k / sum_l(w_l*history_mask_l). Only landmark_00_softmin has nonzero history mass, equal to 1. The mask is read from the bound V3 prior, not copied from all 24 coordinate fields.
mathematical_definition.optional_history: At n>0, use detached immediately preceding forecast Y_(n-1) and exact mu_nk=node_mean_success_delta_z[n,k]. d_nk=z_k(Y_n)-stopgrad(z_k(Y_(n-1)))-mu_nk; H_n=sum_k h_k*d_nk^2/v_nk; P_n=lambda*phase(t_n)^2*C(H_n). Do not divide mu by dt or substitute the whole-window contrast rate. First supported node has no observed edge and P_0=0 even with pre-window cache; interior nodes with lambda>0 require the immediately preceding forecast. With first-design lambda=0, P_n=0 at every node.
mathematical_definition.total_reward: R_n(Y)=A_n(Y)-P_n(Y). phase(t)=clip((t-0)/0.5,0,1); external continuous schedule S(t)=(0.1+0.9*phase)^0=1 at every supported update.
mathematical_definition.gradient: For the already required target forward Y_n=F_theta(x_t, detached self-conditioning, fixed native conditioning), g_t=J_{F_theta}(x_t)^T * grad_Y R_n. Prior/prototype/assignment/history state is detached; no gradient of the affinity head. The geometry gradient is pulled through the actual FLOWR endpoint Jacobian, not treated as an identity or taken with respect to atom-type probabilities.
mathematical_definition.dose_and_application: Set the registered native RMS ratio eta=0.3 and positive schedule S=1. In the inherited controller's RMS convention, the uncapped geometry displacement follows eta*S*RMS(Delta x_native)*g_t/(RMS(g_t)+epsilon); preserve existing native caps and record the delivered dose because their constants are not supplied by this input. Inject after the native step using this lagged g_t. No extra target/head forward is permitted in production.
mathematical_definition.support_and_native_completion: Use the reference's 50 empirical selection nodes t=0,...,0.49 and guidance window [0,0.5]. Positive schedule covers all supported updates; do not invent stage bins, extend to unlearned nodes, clone/select particles, impose graph/atom-type acceptance, or change slot counts. Finish native inference to t=1.

reward_design.first_experiment_rationale: Hold eta at .3, blocks [0,1,2,1], time ramp 0 and history 0 to isolate finite-maximum robust prototype attraction from the previous target. Do not change dose and history simultaneously. The 24-field mask omits many coordinates in measured R7's full point clouds; this loss may underperform despite observational support.

post_native_reward_response.injection_estimate: g_t dot Delta x_inject, with g_t evaluated at old x_t before the native update.
post_native_reward_response.total_displacement_estimate: At the same frozen reward node/conditioning, a pre-to-post state estimate uses g_t dot (Delta x_native+Delta x_inject). It is not an evaluated new endpoint reward.
post_native_reward_response.limitation: The native step and injection move away from the point of differentiation. Without a fresh target forward the actual post-native/post-injection endpoint and reward are unknown; no measured reward gain is claimed.

one_time_numerical_audit.method: At an interior supported node, freeze conditioning, node, prototypes, assignments, salience and previous forecast. Use a deterministic normalized coordinate direction u; compare autograd g_t dot u with [R(F(x_t+epsilon*u))-R(F(x_t-epsilon*u))]/(2*epsilon) for both epsilons. Two signs times two epsilons require four extra joint target forwards once. Epsilon is in the actual native x_t coordinate units.
one_time_numerical_audit.error_reporting: Report both AD/central-FD values, absolute error and relative error abs(FD-AD)/max(abs(FD),abs(AD),1e-8); retain native-model diagnostic tolerances and disclose near-zero derivatives rather than fabricating a pass.
one_time_numerical_audit.full_zero_requirement: For this new registered loss, run full-generation eta=0/native parity with identical seeds, full budgets, caches and sampler settings; compare all outputs/failure denominators and head scores. R6's old certificate cannot be inherited by a different loss. This full-zero experiment is separate from the four FD forwards and is unexecuted.

states: first supported node: history inactive, including any pre-window cache
interior supported node: immediately preceding detached forecast and active history
future_nonzero_history.reason: Repeat the two-sign, two-epsilon actual-model FD at both states when lambda>0; this is eight one-time audit forwards, never eight extra production forwards per step.

future_registered_comparisons.protocol: After history0 target validation, compare each supported history strength at the same eta=.3, blocks, salience, prototypes, full budgets and paired seeds. Keep all valid/invalid and all/valid/unique/best/Top5 outcomes separate. Freeze a discovery winner before heldout comparisons; do not tune on heldout outcomes.
future_registered_comparisons.regression_backtracking: Compare final all-head mean, not window-only gain. If prototype attraction regresses, retain measured R7 and revise coordinate detail rather than claim success from q values. If a history dose regresses relative to history0 or the measured global parent, backtrack to the stronger measured parent; history hypotheses are not automatically activated. Energy remains secondary after a clear affinity gain.

uncertainties: Predicted affinity uses a model head/joint latent label; it is not measured biochemical affinity.
R6 transient gain with delivered control supports the diagnosis of terminal loss, but does not identify its causal mechanism.

Whole-window coordinate and lineage FDR reflect observational independent-batch associations conditional on score/survival; q is not node-wise fidelity or causality. The single history q=0.04608 is close to the threshold.

History support is selected by a high-minus-low full-window contrast, but the registered penalty targets high absolute per-edge means. The 49 high edges total -1.4667331286332943 z, versus low +0.9413080647672474 z, and contain 22 positive/27 negative increments. This estimand mismatch and changing signs make history an untested empirical target, not proof of persistent affinity or constant approach toward a receptor.
All 24 empirical coordinate curves are preserved; their signs can vary by node. Absolute salience and robust elite attraction are new experimental choices, not proven affinity improvements.
The reference prototype feature representation omits raw point-cloud details that may matter for R7. No covariance comparison certifies that the mask retains the effective target.
Input lacks absolute failure denominators, valid/unique affinity means, paired uncertainty and detailed per-candidate dose/absolute response exports; preserve them in future analyses.
The inherited RMS caps and normalization must be logged at runtime. The nominal eta does not itself establish delivered perturbation.
No new GPU zero, FD, or efficacy test has run; only a literal response and local data consistency checks are supplied.
